title: 六级主题练习 02 · 科技、风险与判断
description: 原创缩编练习，学习情境为虚构，覆盖非听力题型。参考六级试卷中的金融、生态和数字生活章节，全文为原创缩编内容。

sections.title: 写作
sections.instructions: 按题目要求完成写作。提交后查看参考范文，自行核对。
study_paragraphs: Universities should teach students how to evaluate information produced by artificial intelligence. AI tools can summarise a large amount of material, but a fluent answer is not necessarily an accurate one. Students need to check sources, compare explanations and recognise when a question requires expert judgment. This training would not mean rejecting AI. A class could ask students to test an AI answer against an academic article and explain every correction. Such work develops digital skills and intellectual honesty. As AI becomes common in study and employment, the ability to question a convenient answer will be as important as the ability to produce one quickly.

sections.title: 选词填空
sections.instructions: 从词库选词，每词只用一次。
paragraphs: A financial crisis can begin with a small [1] ______ that institutions choose to ignore. When borrowers take on [2] ______ debt, a change in interest rates may make repayments difficult. Banks need to [3] ______ whether customers can continue paying. If information is hidden, confidence may [4] ______ quickly. Good regulation cannot remove every risk, but it can make problems more [5] ______ before they spread.
study_paragraphs: A financial crisis can begin with a small warning that institutions choose to ignore. When borrowers take on excessive debt, a change in interest rates may make repayments difficult. Banks need to assess whether customers can continue paying. If information is hidden, confidence may collapse quickly. Good regulation cannot remove every risk, but it can make problems more visible before they spread.

questions.explanation: 第 1 空填入 warning，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 2 空填入 excessive，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 3 空填入 assess，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 4 空填入 collapse，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 5 空填入 visible，结合上下文和句法关系判断。

sections.title: 信息匹配 · 科技、风险与判断
sections.instructions: 根据段落内容完成匹配。
paragraphs: [A] A forest team studied native trees before planting. It copied the mixed structure of remaining woodland instead of planting one fast-growing species.
[B] The team set targets for soil, insects and water as well as tree numbers. Some plots were left alone for comparison.
[C] Farmers feared that a new forest would take land. The organisers changed the boundary and paid local workers to maintain a firebreak.
[D] After rain removed seedlings, the team recorded the failure and changed the planting season.

The team set targets for soil, insects and water as well as tree numbers. Some plots were left alone for comparison.

After rain removed seedlings, the team recorded the failure and changed the planting season.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · The quiet signal
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A wearable device warned cyclists of vehicles behind them. At first it sounded for every nearby object, so users ignored it. Engineers added speed, distance and direction. The device gave a stronger warning only when several signals suggested real risk. A warning must compete for attention carefully: if every event appears urgent, people hear nothing.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · When a number is not enough
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A museum announced that an online exhibition had received one million visits. The education team examined how long people stayed and which objects they opened. Many visitors looked briefly at a popular image, while a smaller group read background material for much longer. The museum reported both reach and engagement because a large audience alone could not explain the exhibition’s value.

sections.title: 翻译 · 中译英
sections.instructions: 完成翻译，提交后查看参考译文。
paragraphs: 数字技术正在改变人们获取公共服务的方式。在线平台可以帮助居民提交申请、查询进度和获得提醒，但并不是所有人都能熟练使用数字设备。因此，公共机构还应保留电话和面对面的服务渠道，确保技术进步不会制造新的障碍。
study_paragraphs: Digital technology is changing the way people access public services. Online platforms can help residents submit applications, check progress and receive reminders, but not everyone can use digital devices with confidence. Public institutions should keep telephone and face-to-face channels so that technological progress does not create new barriers.
